arStrings.szText:
Killing an enemy generates {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} stacks of Chaos and dealing direct damage to a Boss generates {c_number}[SF_3]{/c} stacks of Chaos. At {c_number}[SF_4]{/c} stacks, unleash a salvo of {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} that each deal {c_random}[SF_16]{/c} damage of your highest damage type.

Your {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} gain {c_number}[SF_6 * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance and deal {c_random}[SF_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
